defects.symptom: Object-to-string coercion in workbook metric row
defects.root_cause: Object values (e.g. pass_requires: { UNRESOLVED: 0 }) written to workbook via String(v) without typed formatter.

defects.symptom: Shared-string index leak in regression error column (empty cell)
defects.root_cause: Empty string "" in regression test error column. ExcelJS deduplicates empty strings; operator tools display sharedStrings index (970 in QA repair workbook).
defects.fix: formatErrorDetails(passed, error) → PASS uses «Not applicable — test passed»

defects.symptom: Shared-string index leak in narrative column (empty cell)
defects.root_cause: Empty narrative fields (replacement, representative_phrases, detail) deduplicated to sharedStrings[2464].
defects.fix: formatNarrative() with explicit sentinels; forbid bare empty strings

defects.symptom: Legacy four-digit placeholder literal in narrative scan
defects.root_cause: Legacy placeholder literal in narrative scan fixtures.
